description: This file implements a chat interface with WebSocket transport, including connection management, message handling, and streaming response processing.

classes.name: Chat
classes.description: A class managing chat history, WebSocket connection, and message exchange with a server.

classes.name: Connection
classes.description: Handles WebSocket transport, message dispatching, and connection lifecycle.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Sends a prompt and returns the parsed JSON response.

methods.name: _append
methods.description: Appends a message to the chat history.

methods.name: _connection
methods.description: Establishes or returns an existing WebSocket connection.

methods.name: _dispatchEvent
methods.description: Handles incoming chat chunks and manages chat sinks.

methods.name: _post
methods.description: Initiates a chat request and returns an async iterable of response chunks.

methods.name: asString
methods.description: Concatenates chunks from an async iterable into a single string.

methods.name: iterablePump
methods.description: Creates a stream and iterable pair for chunked data handling.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message over the WebSocket transport.

methods.name: _dispatchMessage
methods.description: Dispatches incoming messages, resolving or rejecting pending promises.

methods.name: _close
methods.description: Closes the connection and rejects pending promises.

methods.name: isClosed
methods.description: Checks if the connection is closed.
